novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: it predicts that “harmful MEANING is only reconstructed by later layers” than the layer where “the refusal decision is committed,” yielding the signed ordering “L_decode > L_check” and a gap that widens with encoding difficulty and scale. Searches for “encoded cipher jailbreak layerwise decoding refusal,” “decode-before-check LLM safety,” “refusal trajectory encoded prompts,” and “late-layer harmfulness probe cipher jailbreak” found CipherChat’s behavioral capability–vulnerability result and the 2026 work “Tracing the Dynamics of Refusal,” which studies layer-token refusal trajectories and encoded-input boundary cases, but neither states or measures a decode-depth versus refusal-commitment ordering; shallow-safety and activation-patching work likewise supplies ingredients rather than this relationship. The step is therefore more than a direct transfer or renamed standard probe: it requires a new core relationship connecting the depth at which encoded semantics emerge to the earlier causal commitment of refusal, although it remains an advance within established cipher-jailbreak and layerwise-safety frameworks rather than a new paradigm.
